scope: AP3 experiment; no independent gate acceptance or CF02 approval

groups.observed: Six actual modes/end pairs in CLI and authenticated HTTP; pre-end samples stable; immediate terminal STOP. Unreadable/malformed/inconsistent observations explicitly injected in real Core execution.
groups.not_executed: An actual mid-transaction session rewrite or an unobserved change after the last completion sample; only initial test-mode assignments were authorized.

groups.observed: Inherited Core completion and genuine dol_syslog/file export at CLI DEBUG7; actual HTTP logger level4. Zero attempted post-terminal SQL including actual HTTP shutdown. Unknown profile denied before transaction.
groups.limits: Pinned standard file logger only; unsupported-profile negative is declared/injected, no arbitrary third-party exporter was run.

groups.observed: Nine authenticated HTTP cases; actual I105 files session path; fresh GET result readbacks and consumed replay refusals; real files-handler reopen failure; temporary server ended.
groups.limits: Temporary PHP cli-server with genuine main.inc.php, not Apache SAPI. E15 consumption remains durable, result persistence explicitly uncertain; arbitrary handlers not qualified.

groups.observed: SUCCESS/CONTINUE; SUCCESS/STOP; acknowledged rollback/STOP; UNKNOWN/STOP; acknowledged COMMIT + checkpoint failure/STOP. Followers NOT_PROCESSED in measured result.
groups.limits: Synthetic member slots/probe DML, no product booking orchestrator. E15 durable PENDING_RESULT_RECORD avoids a false persisted result claim.

groups.observed: No attempted terminal lab SQL, next-member preflight, follower DML, compensation or retry; zero mail/PDF calls in isolated orchestrator. Independent auditor connection is explicitly distinct.
groups.limits: Only initial new-connection Completion assignments per separate Owner permission; no adapter normalization. Artificial mail/PDF paths are absent, existing product paths remain unqualified.

groups.observed: Real discarded COMMIT/ROLLBACK server OK => UNKNOWN/STOP with errno2006; real foreign1568; own connection close; real session failure; unsupported declared profiles refused.
groups.not_executed: Actual unsupported custom DB session/logger handlers and actual late Completion rewrite; contradictory classification observations are injection, not proof of detecting every physical change.
